name: ETH VolFavorite v2
description: ETH VolFavorite with two execution fixes for live data: realized vol no longer jumps after a price-feed gap, and the live-vs-backtest vol scale is re-measured (v1 used 1.09 from one partial day; a month of recordings says about 1.02). Same signal and model as eth-volfav: buy the favourite late in the window when the market's implied vol is well above a vol forecast.
hypothesis: Same edge as eth-volfav (ETH's 15-minute market overprices short-horizon vol). v1 trades ~27% less often than its backtest because rv_scale=1.09 overstates live vol, and feed gaps inflate rv for up to 4h. Fixing both should bring live trade frequency and per-contract results in line with the walk-forward. Wrong if paper per-contract results fall clearly below eth-volfav's paper/live results on the trades v1 would not have taken.
next: Live since 2026-10-14 03:05 UTC: $1,000 on the crypto shard, 1%/order, rv_scale=1.02, slip_c=1, stop-loss $200, max 25/order, 50/market; server tmux live-eth-volfav, log ~/kalshi-data/logs/live-eth-volfav.log. Switched after ~28h of paper (v2 +13.9c/ct on 22 markets vs v1 +13.3c on 15; 8 extra markets +12.6c) at the user's request, before the planned 10-day check. Keep comparing v2's extra trades against v1 paper; revisit ~Oct 22-26.
